description: CSS changes how a web page looks. It is like choosing colours and spaces for a school poster. You can make a heading blue, give a box a border, and line up a row of cards. Learn a little HTML first. Then try one CSS rule at a time. Later lessons show how to make a page fit both a phone and a large screen.
versionNote: Targets modern CSS as implemented by current browsers in 2026: flexbox, grid, custom properties, container queries, :has() and nesting are all assumed to be available.
whatYouWillLearn: Choose colours and sizes for words on a page
Add borders and space around boxes
Arrange items in rows and columns
Make a page fit small and large screens
learningObjectives: Choose colours and sizes for words on a page
Add borders and space around boxes
Arrange items in rows and columns
Make a page fit small and large screens

seo.title: CSS Tutorial – Learn Modern CSS Step by Step
seo.description: Free CSS tutorial: selectors, the box model, typography, flexbox, grid, responsive design, animations and variables, with runnable examples and quizzes.
